title: Zesty Vietnamese Rice Noodle Soup
description: A bright, low-sodium rice noodle soup with lemon zest, fresh lime, and aromatic lemongrass, perfect for meal prep and a quick lunch.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a gentle simmer in a medium pot.
Add the bruised lemongrass stalk and kaffir lime leaves, letting the aromatics steep for 5 minutes.
Stir in the sliced mushrooms and carrot, cooking for another 3 minutes until tender.
Add the cubed tofu and let the soup simmer for 2 minutes, then remove the lemongrass and lime leaves.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lime zest, fresh lime juice, and toasted sesame oil.
Fold the whisked lime mixture into the soup, then season with a pinch of salt if desired.
Toss in the rice vermicelli, cooking just until they soften, about 1-2 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve with a generous sprinkle of chopped cilantro and sliced green onions.
